blurb: Guests can experience the Halifax Harbour by the hour or full day excursions including sunset tours, boating and hiking tours, and full day private boat tours. They also offer deep sea fishing tours and transportation services such as round trip ferry service to Birch & Anchor with dining options. The tours provide unique views of Halifax from the water and opportunities for social and corporate events.
